# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime and platform refinements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform compatibility and runtime efficiency across rendering, streams, and text shaping. It updates native packaging for WebGPU and Apple platforms, improves Android rendering synchronization, and reduces allocations in image and HarfBuzzSharp operations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering synchronized** — Android GL texture rendering now synchronizes with the display refresh cycle for smoother, more predictable presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Fixes front-buffered managed streams retaining data after it is no longer needed, reducing unnecessary managed memory use. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image pixel copies optimized** — Managed image pixel copy operations perform less work, improving efficiency when applications frequently read or copy pixels. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **HarfBuzzSharp allocations reduced** — UTF-32 input buffers are pooled and feature-string formatting avoids native allocation while preserving existing decoding behavior. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **WebGPU native support packaged** — The WebGPU implementation is included in libSkiaSharp.a so WebAssembly builds receive the required native support. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Apple deployment baselines updated** — Native assets now target updated minimum Apple platform versions for supported iOS, macOS, and tvOS environments. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Linux HarfBuzz bindings localized** — Linux native builds bind bundled HarfBuzz functions locally, keeping the binding aligned with the library shipped by SkiaSharp. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
